description: Each word pinches down a hair, then pops past full size and settles: a cartoon wind-up on a real spring.
inspiration: Classic cel anticipation (squash before the stretch), applied to UI-scale type; title cards that want a wink, not a bounce-house.
usage_notes: Per-word only: per-character at this bounce reads as jitter. Keep phrases short (2–5 words). The anticipation is what sells it, so if opacity_duration grows past ~180ms the wind-up happens while the word is still invisible and the effect collapses into a plain pop.
x_intent_notes: Stiff and under-damped with a sharper wind-up: the pop lands on the beat and rings once more.
